newsitem.title: USA: Alternative Distribution files for initial offer.
newsitem.headline: Alternative Distribution files for initial offer.

text.p: Alternative Distribution Systems Inc said Wednesday it registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission a proposed initial public offering of 1.6 million shares of its common stock.
The offering is expected to be priced at $10 to $12 a share in late March, the company said in a statement.
Alternative Distribution provides transportation, warehousing and third-party logistics services to the metals industry.
All of the shares will be offered by the company.
Underwriters are led by William Blair & Co LLC and A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc.
